personal.name: Aditya Shedge
personal.description: I create compelling visual experiences through photography, design, and seamless event management. From capturing live performances to designing brand identities and orchestrating memorable events.

about.title: About Me
about.description: As a multi-disciplinary creative professional, I blend photography, graphic design, and event management to deliver comprehensive visual and experiential solutions. My expertise spans capturing dynamic live performances, creating compelling brand identities, and orchestrating seamless events that leave lasting impressions.

projects.title: Wedding Photography
projects.description: Captured the vibrant energy and intricate rituals of multi-day wedding events, from colorful Mehendi ceremonies to joyous Sangeet celebrations and sacred Wedding ceremonies. Each moment was framed with a natural, storytelling style, highlighting emotion, tradition, and candid joy through professional wedding documentation.

projects.title: Event Photography
projects.description: Professional documentation of diverse events including corporate gatherings, cultural celebrations, and special occasions. Captured the excitement of live performances, audience engagement, and key moments with focus on detail, emotion, and the unique atmosphere that defines each event.

projects.title: Portrait Photography
projects.description: Professional portrait sessions capturing personality, character, and authentic expressions. Specialized in creating compelling portraits that tell individual stories through careful attention to lighting, composition, and emotional connection with subjects.

projects.title: Product Photography
projects.description: High-quality commercial product photography for brands and businesses. Specialized in creating visually appealing product shots that highlight features, textures, and brand identity while maintaining professional standards for marketing and e-commerce use.

projects.title: Outdoor & Travel Photography
projects.description: Capturing the beauty of natural landscapes, outdoor adventures, and travel experiences. Focused on showcasing the essence of different locations through dynamic compositions and natural lighting techniques.

projects.title: Swadesh Foundation - NGO Documentation
projects.description: Comprehensive visual documentation for Swadesh Foundation's social initiatives and community programs. Captured the impact of their work through storytelling photography that highlights community engagement, social causes, and meaningful moments of change.

projects.title: ACC Campaign Graphics
projects.description: Creative graphic design work for ACC brand campaign, developing visual assets and marketing materials that align with brand guidelines while creating engaging content for promotional activities and brand communication.

projects.title: Rulane Himachal Festival
projects.description: Cultural event photography for Rulane Himachal Festival, capturing the essence of traditional celebrations, cultural performances, and community gatherings. Documented the vibrant atmosphere and cultural significance of this regional festival.

projects.title: Magazine Cover Design
projects.description: Professional magazine cover design combining photography and graphic design skills to create compelling editorial layouts. Focused on creating visually striking covers that capture reader attention while maintaining editorial standards.

projects.title: Light & Indoor Photography
projects.description: Specialized indoor photography focusing on creative lighting techniques and controlled environments. Explored various lighting setups to create dramatic and artistic indoor shots with emphasis on mood and atmosphere.

projects.title: Social Media & Reels
projects.description: Creative Instagram reels and social media content showcasing behind-the-scenes photography work, client projects, and creative processes. These reels highlight the dynamic nature of photography work and engage audiences with visual storytelling through short-form video content.
